Shooting Blanks

2025
Aluminum, 35mm film, LEDs, plexiglass, custom electronics, 3D-printed components; 148 × 3.5 × 3 cm; edition of 3 + 1 AP

Shooting Blanks (2025) accounts for a mechanical failure during a surreal encounter in Exarchia, where a broken shutter failed to capture a squad of Athenian riot police posing at the behest of a friend’s mother. Left with a transparent roll, the artist reconstructs the lost image by exposing the narrative of the negotiation directly onto the 35mm strip. Illuminated within an industrial housing, the text performs an act of ekphrasis, transforming a Kopfbild (mental image) into a physical artifact. By substituting text for light, the work forces the viewer to “develop” the photograph in their own mind—a process that likely renders the police’s compliance even more ridiculous than reality.
